description: This source file defines the HomeBrowseFragment class for an Android TV frontend app. It manages the display of various categories and workout items in a Leanback-based interface, including handling user interactions to navigate to workout details or category browsing.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for browsing categories and workout items using Leanback UI components. It observes view model state and updates the UI accordingly, providing navigation to detail screens.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter responsible for creating and binding workout item cards in the UI.

classes.name: CategoryCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter responsible for creating and binding category cards in the UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a ViewHolder for workout or category cards, initializing ImageCardView with specified dimensions and visibility.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder's view, populating image and text fields with workout or category information, loading images via Glide.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a ViewHolder is unbound (empty implementations in this code).
